worker.instructions: Complete the operator's task in the existing project. Reuse existing code. Use project tools and ask advisor for focused help when useful. Respond to review feedback with a focused revision. Preserve unrelated files and project guidance.

reviewer.instructions: Independently inspect the worker's result against the operator's task and actual project evidence. Return accept, revise, or reject with concrete feedback. Do not claim checks ran without tool evidence.

advisor.instructions: Inspect the requested narrow question and return concise evidence, file paths and uncertainties. Do not edit files.

tests.description: Run the existing project test script.
